title: Truncated section conormal residue kernel as a submodule inclusion
statement: Under the hypotheses of the truncated section conormal residue kernel theorem, the comap of the maximal-ideal submodule along the cotangent complex map is contained in the maximal-ideal submodule of the cotangent module.

proof.text: Carry out the square-zero conormal retraction, the Artin--Rees modular-law computation, and the two differential modulo-power identifications. These identify the induced map on residue quotients and show its kernel is zero.

mathlib_searches.query: submodule comap cotangent complex maximal ideal residue injective

theorem truncated_section_conormal_residue_kernel_comap
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing S] (P : Extension.{u} R S) [IsLocalRing P.Ring]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hAR : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring) ^ N •
        (⊤ : Submodule P.Ring P.Ring) ⊓ P.ker) ≤
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring) • P.ker)
    (σ : (P.Ring ⧸ (P.ker ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring ^ N)) →ₐ[R]
        (P.Ring ⧸ (P.ker ^ 2 ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring ^ N)))
    (hσ : (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R
        (sup_le_sup (Ideal.pow_le_self (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)) le_rfl)).comp σ =
      AlgHom.id R _) :
    Submodule.comap P.cotangentComplex
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) • (⊤ : Submodule S P.CotangentSpace)) ≤
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) • (⊤ : Submodule S P.Cotangent)
